这游戏除了逻辑解密之外，其实还考验了爬塔策略。如果只是追求通关而不是刷分，很多根本无法靠逻辑推理来判断的箱子可以无脑略过。毕竟这游戏太肉鸽了，很多时候会出现凭运气二选一的状况，没道具根本赌不起（有道具也可能无法回本）。 在数值上，把攻击力堆到B，确保能打得过boss后也就不需要再强化自己了。 后面四个高级模式中，最喜欢疑神疑鬼模式，要转两个弯，畅享解谜的快乐；第二喜欢扫雷模式，结合了我最喜欢的逻辑和扫雷游戏，很新鲜。讨厌强盗模式，很少有线索能直接锁定强盗，每一局几乎都避不开损失，发育特别艰难。 总的来说，是个很有趣的小游戏，可以重复刷。就是这游戏好像没有做steam成就系统，有点可惜。

Mimic Logic is an RPG Maker puzzle game set in a JRPG style. The puzzles revolve around trying to identify groups of treasure boxes while avoiding the deadly mimics among them. Numerous modes/dungeons and the resource management both add a lot to the gameplay variety, and makes for a very interesting challenge to learn how the chests work. In fact, the gameplay focuses so primarily on the logic puzzles that everything else is generally secondary and undistracting. The combat is simple, and the game runs quick from encounter to encounter with next to no filler dialogue. Additionally, no Steam achievements and the game's credits being reachable relatively easily means that the game doesn't expect any heavy commitment to complete it. The game will respect your time and let you play as much or as little as you'd like. The music adds a lot to the puzzling experience, and the visuals do what they need to help make the game fun. With all of that in mind, I can strongly recommend this game! It's very interesting and a lot of fun to learn how it works! Just don't open a mimic, whatever you do... (• ▽ •;)
